caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate hair comb positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The comb is rendered in shades of brown and dark gray, with a gently curved, wide upper section and nine long, evenly spaced, downwards-pointing tines. Along the top edge of the comb, there are nine faceted, dark-colored gemstones or beads arranged in a row; these are each colored in dark tones, creating a contrast with the lighter background and the brown body of the comb. The paper is unmarked except for the artist's name, "G. Lembero," written in small, simple black letters in the lower left corner.
title: Comb
